body.purpose: Default interface text and table cells.

label.purpose: Uppercase stat labels, table headers, group labels; 11px floor.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Menus, listboxes, region picker and search suggestions only.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Neutral action; the default for most buttons.
components.css: .ds-btn{height:40px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid hsl(var(--border));background:hsl(var(--surface) / .8);color:hsl(var(--foreground));font:500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;transition:background-color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),border-color .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);cursor:pointer}.ds-btn:hover{background:hsl(var(--accent));border-color:hsl(var(--border-strong))}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px;}

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Inverted high-emphasis action, one per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{height:40px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:6px;border:0;background:hsl(var(--foreground));color:hsl(var(--surface));font:500 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;transition:opacity .15s;cursor:pointer}.ds-btn-primary:hover{opacity:.9}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px;}

components.name: Search Pill
components.description: Riot ID combobox with region picker; the product's front door.
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:44px;padding:0 6px 0 16px;border-radius:9999px;border:1px solid hsl(var(--border));background:hsl(var(--surface) / .85);color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground));transition:border-color .15s}.ds-search:hover{border-color:hsl(var(--border-strong))}.ds-search:focus-within{border-color:hsl(var(--border-strong));box-shadow:0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ring) / .6)}.ds-search input{flex:1;min-width:0;background:transparent;border:0;outline:0;color:hsl(var(--foreground));font:400 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:hsl(var(--subtle-foreground))}.ds-search-region{height:36px;padding:0 12px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border-radius:9999px;border:1px solid hsl(var(--border));background:hsl(var(--accent) / .6);color:hsl(var(--foreground));font:600 12px 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace}

components.name: Card
components.description: Translucent panel over the backdrop; never nested.
components.html:
Ranked Solo/Duo

Challenger 1,432 LP
components.css: .ds-card{padding:16px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid hsl(var(--border) / .7);background:hsl(var(--surface) / .7);transition:border-color .15s}.ds-card:hover{border-color:hsl(var(--border-strong))}.ds-card-label{margin:0 0 4px;font:500 11px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;letter-spacing:.025em;text-transform:uppercase;color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground))}.ds-card-value{margin:0;font:600 14px 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;color:hsl(var(--foreground))}.ds-tier{font-family:Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;color:hsl(var(--tier-challenger))}

components.name: Result Badges
components.description: Win/loss badges; color always paired with text.

components.name: Segmented Nav
components.description: Queue and game switches; the active segment is filled with accent.
components.html: Solo/DuoFlex
components.css: .ds-seg{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;padding:4px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid hsl(var(--border));background:hsl(var(--surface-sunken) / .7)}.ds-seg-item{height:32px;padding:0 12px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border-radius:4px;color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground));font:400 14px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color .15s,color .15s}.ds-seg-item:hover{background:hsl(var(--accent) / .5);color:hsl(var(--foreground))}.ds-seg-item.is-active{background:hsl(var(--accent));color:hsl(var(--foreground));font-weight:500}.ds-seg-item:focus-visible{outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset: 2px;}

components.name: Stat
components.description: Uppercase label over a tabular numeric value.
components.css: .ds-stat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}.ds-stat span{font:500 11px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;letter-spacing:.025em;text-transform:uppercase;color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground))}.ds-stat strong{font:600 20px/1.25 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:hsl(var(--win))}

narrative.overview:
LolData reads like a scout's dossier on a player: dense, factual, numbers first. The page is a dark, quiet sheet laid over a blurred, darkened League wallpaper, and the only things that light up are the facts a player cares about: win or loss, rank tier, placement. The interface stays out of the way so the data carries the weight; the game's identity shows up in the details (tier colors, crests, champion art), not in chrome.

This is an operate-mode product. Players arrive with a Riot ID, scan a profile or a leaderboard, and leave. Familiar controls, consistent affordances and fast scanning beat expression every time. Density is a feature: tables and match cards pack information, spaced on a 4px grid so it still breathes.

Components are precise and understated: flat surfaces, a hairline border that brightens on hover, no shadows at rest, no scaling on hover. The one signature shape is the rounded search pill, the product's front door.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only, translucent surfaces over a pre-blurred backdrop (`public/backdrop.webp`)
Neutral zinc UI; color reserved for game meaning (win/loss, tiers, placements, trait tiers)
Inter for interface text, Geist Mono tabular numerals for every number
Flat by default; shadows only on floating layers
One component vocabulary for LoL and TFT, fully localized (EN and PT-BR)

rules.name: The Earned Color Rule
rules.body: Color means something in the game or it doesn't appear. No decorative gradients, no brand tints on inactive states; a screen with no results or tiers is grayscale.

rules.name: The Never Alone Rule
rules.body: Win, loss, placement and trait tier are never communicated by color alone: a label, count or icon always travels with it.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: If it is a number, it is `.num`. Numbers are formatted by the locale (`1,432` / `1.432`) through next-intl.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Fixed rem sizes only (Tailwind scale plus `2xs`). No fluid type and no `text-[Npx]`.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces never cast shadows, and hover never lifts or scales. Hover changes border and fill only.

rules.name: The One Layer Rule
rules.body: Never nest a card inside a card. A section holding cards has no card wrapper; inside a card, structure comes from dividers and spacing.

dos: Do build every screen from `src/components/ui` primitives and `src/lib` helpers (`cdn`, `regions`, `tiers`, `queues`, `format`, `riot-id`).
Do use tokens only (`bg-surface/70`, `text-muted-foreground`, `text-win`, `text-tier-gold`); add a token to `globals.css` before inventing a color.
Do render every number with `.num` and format it with next-intl.
Do translate every visible string and `aria-label` in both `messages/en` and `messages/pt-BR`.
Do keep motion to 150–250ms (`duration-fast`/`base`/`slow`), ease-out, for state changes only; `MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"` is global.
Do give every interactive element a real `<button>`/`<Link>` with a visible focus ring.
donts: Don't use raw palette classes (zinc-, slate-, gray-, red-…), hex colors, or `text-[Npx]` in components.
Don't use neon/RGB "gamer" styling: no glow, no colored gradients or light effects as decoration.
Don't nest cards, add hover scale or shadow, or add shadows to resting surfaces.
Don't use unicode glyphs or emoji as icons (←, ⟳, ▾, 🔥); use lucide-react.
Don't convey win/loss, placement or tier by color alone.
Don't render page-level headers, back links or footers; the app shell owns them.
